static_traits.name: Lin Jing
static_traits.social_status: Has a few close friends to confide in, but they cannot fully understand the cognitive distortions; frequently canceling plans with friends last-minute out of worry about potential disasters, friendships thus damaged
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior treatment or experience with similar psychological problems
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude, slightly Anxious; able to express clearly and willing to cooperate with recording and Reflection

basic_info.main_problem: I tend to catastrophize, especially when things do not go as planned. For example, when my car broke down recently, I immediately felt it was a worthless car and felt overwhelmed. This catastrophizing pattern began years ago and became more frequent under stress, leading me to avoid certain situations or take extreme measures to prevent imagined disasters, while Increased anxiety and impaired decision-making.
basic_info.core_demands: When I noticed these thinking patterns affecting my Work decisions and causing Increased anxiety, I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: Catastrophizing began years ago, becoming more frequent under Work pressure and financial Increased stress; when facing sudden situations (e.g. a car blowout) quickly presuming the worst outcome, gradually forming avoidance and Distraction coping habits.

core_beliefs: Once something goes wrong it will develop into the worst case
I cannot effectively handle sudden situations

special_situations.event: Car breaks down from a flat tire on the way to work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a vehicle breakdown occurs, it means the car is worthless, the problem will be hard to solve and very expensive, and I will handle it poorly
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Relieving Anxiety through Distraction (shopping) and avoidance (delaying handling, struggling to focus at Work)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This car is worthless; I cannot fix it; it will cost a lot of money

special_situations.event: Facing challenging or stressful tasks at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If Work does not go smoothly, it equals total failure with terrible consequences
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids certain situations or takes extreme measures to prevent imagined disasters
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Things will fail completely; I cannot cope

special_situations.event: Facing or worrying about financial pressure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If financial problems arise, life will become unbearable and things will be a mess
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using temporary Distraction (shopping) to lower Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Money is not enough; things will become a mess

special_situations.event: Upcoming social plans agreed with friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once going out or things do not go as planned, disaster will strike and I will be unable to cope
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Temporarily cancels plans to avoid potential disaster
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I go out something might happen; I would break down

core_conflict.wish: Longs for controllability and safety, hopes to be understood and supported
core_conflict.fear: Fearing losing control and worst outcomes happening, worrying about being unable to bear the consequences
defense_goal: Reducing Anxiety and maintaining a surface sense of control through avoidance and Distraction

object_relations.self_representation: A fragile individual who struggles to cope with emergencies
object_relations.object_representation: The world/events as uncontrollable and full of risks; others as not truly understanding me

manifestations: Temporarily cancels plans with friends out of worry about potential disaster; friendships are damaged
Feeling that others can hardly understand one's cognitive distortions

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Using shopping as a distraction when catastrophic thoughts appear
Tries to ignore negative automatic thoughts rather than face and process them directly

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: When facing social plans, cancels outings at the last minute, turning energy into self-exhaustion (worrying, distraction)
Not seeking external support in stressful situations, instead enduring alone and self-handling with Distraction

exception_events.target_problem: In sudden situations like vehicle breakdowns, the client usually catastrophizes, feels overwhelmed, and struggles to focus at Work with avoidant behavior.
exception_events.unique_outcome: That time it was just a flat tire; the client fixed it promptly, cost not high, the worst case never happened.
exception_events.reason: Clues: took timely action and gained factual evidence (the problem could be quickly fixed, cost not high), hence this time it did not develop into a disaster.

positive_force: Willing to record and examine automatic thoughts and evidence (reality testing)
Able to recognize instances where 'the worst case usually did not happen'
Willing to seek counseling support and cooperate with homework
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, black-and-white thinking, and overgeneralization are prominent
Avoidance and temporary Distraction (shopping) Habituation, leaving the problem unprocessed
Work pressure and Financial worries reinforcing negative thinking
Anxiety affecting decisions, attention, and sleep, further harming relationships

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophizing with Significant anxiety and avoidance under stressful situations
antecedent: Challenging and stressful tasks at work
Sudden incidents (e.g. a leaking car tire)
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic interpretation of potential negative outcomes and black-and-white thinking, over-focusing on negative cues while ignoring objective evidence
target_behavior.function: Escaping unwelcome emotions and perceived risks, seeking short-term relief
target_behavior.consequence: Declining decision-making ability, impaired attention and Work performance, Sleep disturbance, worsening Social avoidance

target_behavior.behavior: Temporarily cancels plans with friends to avoid imagined disasters
antecedent: Worrying things will not go as planned
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and overgeneralization leading to worst-case Anticipation of going-out situations
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential threats, reducing present Anxiety

target_behavior.behavior: Temporarily relieving Anxiety with shopping Distraction
target_behavior.core_reason: Seeks external short-term stimulation to interrupt negative thoughts and emotions
target_behavior.function: Obtains short-term pleasure and relief, avoids directly processing the problem
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety reduced in the short term but quickly rebounding, the problem not yet resolved
